scanned_at.title: Scan timestamp
scanned_at.description: UTC timestamp at which the MCP assessment was produced; useful to agents deciding whether a result is still fresh.

server_url.title: MCP server URL
server_url.description: Sanitized Streamable HTTP endpoint that was assessed. Authorization credentials are never included.

server_name.title: Server name
server_name.description: MCP server implementation name reported during initialization, when available.

protocol_version.title: Negotiated protocol version
protocol_version.description: MCP protocol version negotiated by initialize and used on subsequent HTTP requests.

reachable.title: Reachable
reachable.description: Whether the scanner received an HTTP response from the MCP endpoint.

tool_count.title: Tool count
tool_count.description: Total tools discovered across all tools/list pagination pages.

score.title: Trust score
score.description: Heuristic 0-100 prioritization score; it is not a security certification.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: Letter band derived from the heuristic score.

scan_mode.title: Scan mode
scan_mode.description: Tells an agent whether tools were eligible for authorized execution or only metadata was analyzed.

tools_tested_dynamically.title: Dynamically tested tools
tools_tested_dynamically.description: Sanitized exact names of tools that received one or more live calls.

dynamic_tool_allowlist.title: Dynamic allowlist
dynamic_tool_allowlist.description: Sanitized exact tool names the operator authorized for live testing.

controlled_probe_url_used.title: Controlled callback used
controlled_probe_url_used.description: Whether an operator-supplied callback URL was submitted during URL-handling checks; the URL itself is not exposed.

summary.title: Finding summary
summary.description: Counts grouped by static and dynamic check categories for routing and prioritization by AI agents.

tools_with_secrets.description: Tools whose advertised metadata contains at least one credential-shaped value.

tools_with_injection_risk.description: Tools with clearly agent-directed or instruction-overriding language.

tools_with_ssrf_prone_params.description: Tools with URL/path-like input surfaces requiring server-side review.

tools_with_poor_schema.description: Tools with missing descriptions or ambiguous parameter contracts.

dynamic_checks_run.description: Whether authorized dynamic mode was entered, even if no advertised tool matched the allowlist.

ssrf_suspicious_tools.description: Allowlisted tools that accepted the controlled callback without an MCP error; null in static mode.

unauth_accessible_tools.description: Allowlisted tools successful in a separately initialized unauthenticated session; null in static mode.

stack_trace_leaks.description: Allowlisted tools returning stack-trace-like text after malformed input; null in static mode.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: Severity-ranked, sanitized findings. Credential matches are described by type and never copied verbatim.

tool.description: Sanitized tool name, or null for a server-level finding.

message.description: Sanitized explanation suitable for an AI agent or human reviewer.

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.description: Run-specific caveats an AI agent should consider before acting on the assessment.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: High-level MCP reachability, inventory, and trust-score results. Complete findings, summary data, and limitations remain available in each dataset item.
